question: Sodium is a reactive metal, which if kept open reacts with ______ to explode and catch fire.
solution:
The correct answer is __**oxygen**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sodium** is a highly reactive metal.
 
• When **sodium** is exposed to air, it reacts vigorously with **oxygen**.
 
• This reaction can lead to an **explosion and fire**.
 
• To prevent this, sodium is typically stored under **oil** to keep it away from air and moisture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium** is an element in the alkali metal group, found in Group 1 of the periodic table.
 
• It has a symbol **Na** and atomic number **11**.
 
• Due to its reactivity, **sodium** is not found in its free form in nature but is found in compounds such as **sodium chloride (table salt)**.
 
• The reaction of sodium with oxygen forms **sodium oxide (Na₂O)**, which is a white solid.
